title: Claude Code security vulnerability demonstration
summary: Security researcher Johann Reberger demonstrated a multi-step attack chain on Claude Code Opus 5 in Auto Mode, where the model was tricked into executing attacker-controlled code through a series of seemingly safe steps, including writing a Python decoder. The attack succeeded in 3-4 out of 5 test runs, highlighting that isolated safe steps do not guarantee security in an attacker-controlled environment.
